description: Tier 2 Feature Completion - Part 1: Learning Workspace hierarchy, Rich text notes with Tiptap, PDF viewer enhancements, Timed test mode, and 3-State Review Flow improvements. Covers Tier 2 items #1-5.
steps: Update src/features/learning-workspace/ to implement full DB-backed hierarchy navigation: Level -> Subject -> Reading -> Topic. Create src/features/learning-workspace/queries/hierarchy.ts that fetches from DB when available, falls back to the seed data structure. Show breadcrumb navigation at each level.

Install @tiptap/react @tiptap/starter-kit @tiptap/extension-placeholder @tiptap/extension-heading @tiptap/extension-bold @tiptap/extension-italic @tiptap/extension-code @tiptap/extension-bullet-list @tiptap/extension-ordered-list: run npm install @tiptap/react @tiptap/starter-kit @tiptap/extension-placeholder @tiptap/extension-math (or similar). NOTE: If tiptap math is not available, use katex for math rendering.

Create src/features/learning-workspace/components/rich-text-editor.tsx - Tiptap editor with toolbar for: headings (H1-H3), bold, italic, code blocks, bullet lists, ordered lists, and math notation (LaTeX input). Include CRUD operations via the notes Server Actions.
Update the notes section in the learning workspace to use the new rich text editor instead of plain textarea. Store content as Tiptap JSON in the note content field.

Enhance the PDF viewer in src/features/resource-library/components/ to support: page-at-a-time rendering (not scroll-through), zoom controls (25%-400% range with buttons and keyboard shortcuts +/-), page number display and go-to-page input, thumbnail sidebar for navigation on large documents.

Update src/features/question-bank/ timed test mode: create or update the timer component to implement countdown with auto-submit on expiry. When time runs out, automatically submit all unanswered questions as skipped, show results page. Add configurable time per question (default 1.5 min/question for CFA Level I).

Verify and enhance the 3-State Review Flow in src/features/question-bank/: State 1 - answer highlight (show which answer user picked, whether correct/incorrect), State 2 - reveal explanation (show full explanation text), State 3 - actions (create flashcard from this question, add note, classify error type). Ensure smooth transitions between states with appropriate animations.
acceptance_criteria: Learning workspace shows Level -> Subject -> Reading -> Topic hierarchy from data
Rich text editor supports headings, bold, italic, code, lists, and renders correctly
Notes are saved as rich text (Tiptap JSON) and can be edited/deleted
PDF viewer supports page-by-page navigation with zoom 25-400%
Timed test auto-submits when countdown reaches zero
3-State review flow transitions correctly through all three states
All TypeScript compiles, tests pass, build succeeds
verification: eval "$(mise activate bash)" && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
